title: Interactive Console Onboarding Overlays and Adaptive Empty States
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and deliver a set of interactive onboarding overlays and adaptive empty-state assets for the Redwood Console first-run experience. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for new accounts by guiding users through three core flows (Create API key, Run a quick test generation, Check cost & latency dashboard). Deliverables include Figma frames, export-ready PNG/SVG artboards, copy variants (short/long), animation specs for micro-interactions, and a small palette for empty-state illustrations. The overlays must support keyboard navigation, be dismissible/persistent per user preference, and include analytics hooks (impression, complete, skipped). This ticket consolidates visual assets for release console-2026.03.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file with separable frames for each overlay and empty state
Exported 1x/2x PNGs and SVGs for illustrations and icons
Copy variants (short / long) for each step and A/B test labels
Animation spec document (Lottie-friendly) describing enter/exit timing and easing
Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order, screen-reader labels, color contrast >= 4.5:1
Assets uploaded to shared Drive and referenced in the design PR
PM sign-off on messaging and sequence
Engineering review for integration hooks (data-layer events defined)
design_notes: Initial concept prioritized progressive disclosure: start with 3 steps and reveal advanced tips after completion
Chosen illustration style: friendly monochrome line art with a single accent color to minimize localization cost
Decided to surface a persistent checklist in the bottom-left corner for power users (toggleable)
Considered full-screen walkthrough but rejected due to interruption to autosave flows and enterprise sessions
Localization: copy tokens prepared for short (1 line) and long (2-3 lines) variants to fit RTL and de-localized languages
Animations: prefer simple fade+translate for entrance; Lottie bundle included for future use
Accessibility: overlays must trap focus, but provide explicit 'Skip tour' button reachable by keyboard
review_feedback: PM (Lena Morales): shorten step titles; users skim. Prefer 3-word maximum for header
Eng (Ravi Patel): add data-layer events 'onboarding_impression', 'onboarding_complete', 'onboarding_skip' and provide example JSON payloads
Security (Jamal Ortiz): ensure API key CTA opens modal with required warnings; do not auto-create keys
Design peer (Hana Lee): reduce drop-shadow depth to match console UI language; update token values in Figma
next_steps: Address engineering feedback on data-layer schemas (Ravi)
Produce 1x/2x asset export and upload to Drive (Ava)
Run quick usability session with 5 new signups and capture time-to-first-success (PM)
Create small A/B test for short vs long copy (PM + Growth)
Finalize animation JSON and handoff to infra for Lottie serving
notes: This ticket collects the visual/asset work required for the first-run onboarding surface. Engineering has prioritized lightweight integration so assets avoid heavy runtime dependencies. Track analytics as part of console instrumentation sprint. If progress stalls, break into two follow-ups: (1) core 3-step overlay + assets, (2) expanded tips & animations.
